site.sitedescription: Spicer Lake is located in New Carlisle, St. Joseph County, northern Indiana. It is a kettle lake formed by stagnant ice embedded in the glacial till left behind when the Lake Michigan Lobe of the Laurentide Ice Sheet retreated into Indiana ca. 15,000 years ago. Much of the kettle has filled in, leaving 5 ha of open water, surrounded by swamp and wetland forests.
